First, March has 31 days, right? So March 5 plus seven days would be March 12. Wait, let me count. March 5 plus one day is the 6th, then 7th, 8th, 9th, 10th, 11th, 12th. Yeah, that's seven days later. So one week from March 5 is March 12. The year is still 1973 because March has more than 12 days, so no need to change the month or year. The options are A. 03/02/1973 and B. 03/12/1973. So the correct answer should be B.
